data.config.yaml:
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317
      http:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4318
exporters:
  debug:
    verbosity: basic
  otlp/jaeger:
    endpoint: jaeger.aqp-local.svc.cluster.local:14317
    tls:
      insecure: true
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [otlp/jaeger, debug]
    metrics:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [debug]

receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317
      http:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4318
exporters:

    verbosity: basic
  otlp/jaeger:
    endpoint: jaeger.aqp-local.svc.cluster.local:14317
    tls:
      insecure: true
service:

    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [otlp/jaeger, debug]
    metrics:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [debug]

api_url.description: AQP API base URL reachable from the host.

endpoints.description: Map of every operator-facing endpoint. The frontend Local Stack card consumes this verbatim.

frontend_url.description: AQP Vite frontend URL reachable from the host.

jaeger_url_in_cluster.description: Jaeger UI endpoint (cluster-internal). Port-forward to access from the host.

kubeconfig_path.description: Filesystem path to the merged kubeconfig the kubernetes / helm providers read.

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace AQP services land in.

registry_host.description: Image registry host:port the cluster pulls from.

registry_localhost.description: Image registry host:port reachable from the host shell.

enabled.description: True when the active cloud_provider engages this module.

images.description: Logical service name -> registry-qualified image reference (cluster-side host).

ready.description: Pseudo-output downstream modules depend on so workloads only deploy after every image push completed.

cloud_provider.description: Active cloud provider. Image build only fires on local/docker.

context_path.description: Repository root used as the docker build context. The environment composition passes path.cwd or a relative ../../../.

frontend_dist_path.description: Relative path (under context_path) to the built Vite bundle. The frontend Dockerfile expects this directory.

local_shell_interpreter.description: Shell executable for local-exec blocks. On Windows prefer Git Bash, e.g. C:/Program Files/Git/bin/bash.exe, to avoid WSL bash shims.

ready_marker.description: Pseudo-input wired from local_cluster.ready so the build only runs after the cluster + registry are up.

registry_host.description: Registry host:port the cluster pulls from (e.g. aqp-registry:5001).

registry_localhost.description: Registry host:port reachable from the host shell (e.g. localhost:5001).

api_service.description: ClusterIP service name for the API.

enabled.description: True when the active cloud_provider engages this module.

frontend_service.description: ClusterIP service name for the frontend bundle.

ingress_name.description: Ingress object name for AQP routes.

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace AQP services landed in.

ready.description: Pseudo-output downstream consumers depend on once every workload has been scheduled.

auth0_client_secret_secret_name.description: Kubernetes Secret name containing the Auth0/OIDC client secret. The secret value itself is provisioned out-of-band.

auth_config_map_name.description: Optional ConfigMap containing public backend auth/SCIM runtime settings.

auth_scim_bearer_token_hash_secret_name.description: Kubernetes Secret name containing the SCIM bearer token hash. The secret value itself is provisioned out-of-band.

cloud_provider.description: Active cloud provider. Workloads only deploy when local/docker (other clouds use cloud-managed Postgres/Redis).

deployment_topology_target.description: Deployment topology target id (for labels and drift checks).

enabled_services.description: Deployment topology service IDs enabled for this target.

frontend_auth_config_map_name.description: Optional ConfigMap containing public frontend auth settings.

images.description: Service -> image reference map produced by module.aqp_images.

ingress_class.description: k3d ships Traefik out of the box; cloud installs override this with their own ingress class.

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace AQP services land in. Created by the kubernetes module ahead of this one.

namespaces.description: Optional logical -> actual namespace map (forwarded from the root composition).

ollama_host.description: Ollama endpoint reachable from inside the cluster. k3d injects host.docker.internal -> host gateway automatically.

ready_marker.description: Pseudo-input wired to module.aqp_images.ready so workloads only deploy after images are pushed.

warehouse_host_path.description: Host path mounted into the api/worker pods for the Iceberg warehouse. Defaults to /var/lib/aqp-warehouse so the cluster can persist across restarts.

cluster_name.description: k3d cluster name (matches the input variable).

enabled.description: True when the active cloud_provider engages this module.

kubeconfig_path.description: Filesystem path to the merged kubeconfig the kubernetes / helm providers should read.

ready.description: Pseudo-output downstream modules can depend on for ordering.

registry_host.description: Image registry host:port reachable from the host AND the cluster.

registry_localhost.description: Registry host:port reachable from outside the cluster (used for docker push).

cloud_provider.description: Active AQP cloud provider. Resources only provision when this equals 'local' or 'docker'.

cluster_name.description: k3d cluster name (idempotent — re-applies are no-ops).

k3d_image.description: k3s image used by k3d under the hood.

kubeconfig_path.description: Path the module writes the merged kubeconfig to. The local environment composition points provider "kubernetes".config_path at this file.

lb_http_port.description: Host port mapped to the cluster Traefik HTTP loadbalancer.

lb_https_port.description: Host port mapped to the cluster Traefik HTTPS loadbalancer.

local_shell_interpreter.description: Shell executable for local-exec blocks. On Windows prefer Git Bash, e.g. C:/Program Files/Git/bin/bash.exe, to avoid WSL bash shims.

registry_name.description: k3d-managed image registry name. Maps to localhost:<registry_port>.

registry_port.description: Localhost port the k3d registry binds to.

app_version.description: Image tag for the aqp-* container images. Bump to publish a new build.

enabled_services.description: Deployment topology service IDs enabled for this target.

lb_http_port.description: Host port mapped to Traefik :80 (the AQP API + frontend ingress lands here).

local_shell_interpreter.description: Shell executable used by Terraform local-exec. Set to Git Bash on Windows.

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace AQP services land in. Matches the canonical aqp-local slot.

registry_port.description: Localhost port the k3d-managed registry binds to. Cluster pulls from aqp-registry:5001.
